decision.reason: The linked PR [ev-c544b606e326] says v1 fully drops the ConfigMap-based logging configuration, and the changed files [ev-cf5b63caae53] show charts/karpenter/templates/configmap-logging.yaml was removed. That identifies roughly what was removed. It does not name the Helm values key or ConfigMap keys that exposed environments would be setting. The evidence never explains the "Add Log Paths" half: no new values key, flag or setting is named [ev-6ec6b4ea132d][ev-2b055c3f28a3]. It also does not say what happens to an environment that still supplies the logging ConfigMap or its values (ignored, rejected or broken). The values.yaml/deployment.yaml diff or the settings.md changes are needed to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
